title: The Carrier Wave — EN/ES/FR (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 96bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers sparse percussion cosmic signal transmission language learning EN ES FR
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
There's a signal in the static, a voice behind the noise
A carrier wave that hums beneath the satellite decoys
It moves between the towers, through the copper and the air
A frequency of longing, a transmission from somewhere

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
Hay una onda portadora que viaja sin cesar
[There is a carrier wave that travels without end]
A través del espacio, buscando su lugar
[Through space, searching for its place]
Los mensajes perdidos flotan en la señal
[Lost messages float in the signal]
Buscando una antena que los pueda descifrar
[Searching for an antenna that can decode them]

[Chorus — English]
Carrier wave, carry me home
Through the noise and the static, I'm not alone
Carrier wave, steady and true
Somewhere in the signal, I'm reaching you

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
L'onde porteuse traverse la nuit
[The carrier wave crosses the night]
Elle porte les voix de ceux qui ont fui
[It carries the voices of those who have fled]
Dans le spectre électrique, les mots sont vivants
[In the electric spectrum, the words are alive]
La fréquence de l'âme dans le vent
[The frequency of the soul in the wind]

[Outro — All three languages]
Carrier wave… onda portadora… onde porteuse
The signal never dies — la señal nunca muere — le signal ne meurt jamais
That's my boy
